verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents MFA for application users (appwrite-docs-4), so half the story has first-party support. However, its federated login is described only as 30+ social OAuth providers like GitHub, Google and Apple (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-45), which is adjacent to enterprise SSO but not the same capability. Missing for 10: any evidence of enterprise SAML or OIDC SSO, any way to make MFA mandatory for all users, any per-app SSO enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
